title: Workflow Economy Clean Authority Cutover
summary: Replace the duplicated FlowDoc coordination authority with one workflow economy policy derived from the user-approved twenty-item brief, then cut over atomically so replaced rules become historical and closed PLAN rooms remain read-only.
expectedOutput: One approved design and implementation plan for an atomic Project Control authority cutover covering PLAN responsibility, Work Size, Risk Tier, proof and document budgets, bounded WORK authority, evidence reuse, context compaction, completion semantics, stop rules, owner overrides, and a generated Current Truth Snapshot.
riskSummary: A partial migration could leave two active rule sets or remove a safety invariant. The design therefore requires an atomic entrypoint cutover, behavior tests, historical readability, and no reuse of closed PLAN or WORK execution context.
